boundedDictionaryProbe.build: The runner builds libdxfrw_test_adapter, then compiles a scratch executable with -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror and links it to the built adapter and libdxfrw.
boundedDictionaryProbe.result: PASS: captured raw bodies, detached UTF-16 names, string presence/size footer and ordered handle streams agree with the typed unique dictionaries and the independently decoded LibreDWG 0.14 trace. Five source frames are tested; this is a standalone research observer and does not relax any output guard.
boundedDictionaryProbe.negativeControls: 54 dictionary mutations covering body, string byte, footer, owner/reactor/item role and target, inserted extra body bit, truncated handle stream and extra handle byte are rejected; original-byte retries succeed for all but the appended-byte case. The extra-body-bit mutation changes the declared body endpoint and is rejected by the fixed-profile endpoint check; it does not independently prove that an otherwise accepted length cannot hide a body gap. Separately, existing EED role/target/text/code/truncation controls pass. These are research-observer controls, not file-export destination or adapter retry tests.
